about: EVERY number we made up lives here, labelled ASSUMPTION with what it is based on. The UI and README read from this file. Replace with real numbers (e.g. from Habitat OC) and change the label to the source id.

annual_income.label: ASSUMPTION
annual_income.basis: Demo family. For 4 people this is VERY LOW income in OC (limit $93,050, HCD 2026 State Income Limits p.11)

bedrooms.label: ASSUMPTION
bedrooms.basis: Demo home size; HSC 50052.5(h) sizes the cap by bedrooms (3BR = household of 4)

housing_share.label: ASSUMPTION
housing_share.basis: Assumed household budget only (Lane 3 brief: ~30-35% of income, source lane3_brief). The legal benchmark is HSC 50052.5(b), coded in finance.statutory_price

habitat_mortgage_rate.label: UNKNOWN
habitat_mortgage_rate.basis: Habitat OC's actual rate is unknown: ask them. UI lets you enter one

statutory_housing_cost.basis: Items 25 CCR 6920 counts as owner 'housing cost' besides principal and interest (read 2026-11-07, Cornell LII copy). Every dollar value below is a placeholder: replace with a real quote, the HOA budget, and the local housing authority's utility allowance schedule.

property_tax_rate.label: ASSUMPTION
property_tax_rate.basis: 6920(b). Placeholder ~1.1% of price: California's 1% general levy plus local voter-approved add-ons, which vary by tax rate area (not checked)

utilities_allowance.label: ASSUMPTION
utilities_allowance.basis: 6920(e). Placeholder $/month; real figure = local PHA utility allowance schedule (not checked)

hoa_fees.label: ASSUMPTION
hoa_fees.basis: 6920(f). Assumes a detached home with no HOA

loan_insurance.label: ASSUMPTION
loan_insurance.basis: 6920(a). Assumes no mortgage insurance (e.g. a nonprofit first loan): UNKNOWN per lender

space_rent.label: ASSUMPTION
space_rent.basis: 6920(g). Assumes the home is not on rented land (a land trust ground lease would add this)

cost_per_home_defaults.basis: Copied from the event's SYNTHETIC worked example (source synthetic_deal). Replace with a real deal.

build_cost.label: ASSUMPTION
build_cost.basis: Placeholder; replace with a real quote

cost_per_sqft.label: ASSUMPTION
cost_per_sqft.basis: Terner Center statewide ADU owner survey (blog, Apr 22 2021): median $150,000 or $250/sq ft. Statewide, historical, not OC; likely low today. Excludes site-specific and some soft costs. Replace with a local quote

monthly_rent.label: ASSUMPTION
monthly_rent.basis: Rentometer OC 1-bedroom average (source rentometer_oc; data date not shown)

monthly_rent_by_bedrooms.label: ASSUMPTION
monthly_rent_by_bedrooms.basis: Market rent per unit type. Only 1BR has a figure (Rentometer, third-party, data date not shown). Studio and 2BR are UNKNOWN: the user enters them. HUD FY2026 Fair Market Rents (Santa Ana-Anaheim-Irvine HMFA) are the better source but huduser.gov blocks automated fetches; copy them in by hand. HUD FMR is GROSS rent (includes utilities), not contract rent

max_homes_default.label: ASSUMPTION
max_homes_default.basis: Keep under 10 homes: 10+ may trigger SB 4 prevailing wage (UNVERIFIED) and SB 684/1123 caps at 10
